column3: Universal n-dimensional arbitrary norm: Euclidean simplex does not survive arbitrary norm; packing lower bounds do not give n+1 equidistant points. No exact construction mechanism; no source body inspected.
All centred norm balls and all d>=2 require an optimality-to-degree theorem; naive kissing-number packing is not a bridge to Steiner optimality. No finite certificate or source-body clearance.

All market sizes, preference and coalition conventions are not specified fully in the literal record. N=1 endpoint objections would be domain corrections, not substantive resolutions. Link-rule definitions required before enumeration.

Finite-n expectation identity is the classical random assignment formula; literal attribution to Aldous confuses the asymptotic result with finite-n work. No fresh claim; actual source/successor proof bodies not read here, so bibliographic signal only.

Single absolute c must work for all finite abelian groups with faithful irredundant covers. Elementary abelian counting instances do not control mixed primes/exponents or essentiality; no full-scope bound route.

Requires every admissible Hilbert type and generic added points, with precise first-neighborhood Hilbert function; literal conflates configuration and fattening. No all-degree ideal-rank argument or bounded witness.

One sequence must work uniformly for every finite-dimensional Lie algebra; base field/characteristic and ideal L(u) conventions absent. Engel methods do not automatically identify solvable rather than nilpotent radical.

Uniform determinant bounds for every facet and edge star in dimension n>=3 must imply algebraicity. Restatement of a difficult rigidity conjecture; finitely inspecting facets cannot certify the quantified hypothesis.

Equality of both Walkup constants at45 includes existence for every allowable f-vector and exclusion below; individual triangulations cannot certify either global half. No full-scope construction/classification mechanism.

Uniqueness is up to combinatorial triangulation isomorphism among all15-vertex triangulations of the named4-manifold. Vertex-transitivity restriction or an enumeration subset would miss full scope; no bounded complete search certificate.
Characteristic-zero nil identities for all n require optimal Nagata-Higman bound. Low-degree symbolic checks are instances, not an all-n reduction; no short universal multilinear mechanism.

All B-graphs and every maximum stable set require simultaneous disjoint omega_e-cliques through prescribed vertices. Numerical inequality alone is weaker; B-graph definition and transversal-clique packing obstruction need source context.
Literal is presented as a proposition, with R_t undefined. Cannot treat its open label as evidence of a new question; actual lemma/proposition and proof must be inspected before any join-bound work.
All g>=3 and levels L>=2 include rational rank and stronger integral computation. Stable-range rational results would not settle small genus or integral torsion; no finite full-scope route.

All Dantzig figures require three internally disjoint geodesics. Small-dimensional exceptions could be missing domain conditions; Hirsch-related prior and actual source scope must be checked before computational investment.

All finite groups, all three conjugators, solvable generated subgroup criterion. This is a solvable Baer-Suzuki characterization; alternating small-group experiments do not settle arbitrary finite almost-simple groups; substantial classification/prior burden.

For each fixed d a positive constant probability as n tends to infinity at exact Ramanujan threshold is stronger than a2sqrt(d-1)+epsilon bound. Asymptotic spectral edge control needed, no small certificate.

Literal planar fan has crossings/overlaps and is not itself a spatial embedding; lifting convention essential. Count of links in a preferred lifting would not lower-bound all spatial embeddings of every K_mn.

An absolute stability threshold c for all permutation degrees requires structural intersecting-family analysis; checking maximum stars is not near-maximum stability. Strong known-theorem/prior risk; no primary successor body read.

All complex central arrangements require both topological upper bound and cup-length lower-bound equality. Combinatorial cohomology calculations only provide one half; conventions for TC and dependencies require primary body.

Every d>3 and activity above uniqueness threshold asks approximation hardness unless RP=NP. Known hardness literature is a strong prior objection; no reduction or primary successor proof inspected, so no formal resolution claimed.
Literal includes k=1 where binom(1,2)-binom(1,1)=-1 cannot be an eigenspace dimension. This is a domain/endpoint correction; substantive admissible-k spectral assertion untouched. No credit.

Literal k=1 has no distinct pair a,b, so named-set classification cannot hold as written. No substantive family result follows from repairing this endpoint; larger-k structure and primary definitions remain unresolved here.

Literal c=k=1 again predicts negative dimension; small admissibility violations do not refute the intended uniform qualitative-independence spectral conjecture. No source-corrected all-parameter route.

Schatten q-range is omitted. At q=1 trace additivity gives equality routinely; q>1 requires a genuine block-compression inequality and q<1 is not a norm. Scalar blocks alone cannot resolve arbitrary block dimensions.

Full possible-base classification up to c' requires ruling out all unlisted hereditary tournament speeds, not just realizing recurrence roots. Literal typographic defects uncredited; no general exclusion proof.
